subject: Media Literacy
title: Podcasts: Audio's Comeback
description: A micro-lesson that makes Podcasts: Audio's Comeback usable.

hook.text: In 2014, the podcast Serial became a phenomenon. A murder case, told weekly, gripped millions.

buildup.text: Podcasts revived long-form audio storytelling — something radio had abandoned for music and talk shows.

discovery.text: Unlike radio, podcasts have no gatekeepers. Anyone with a microphone can reach a global audience.

twist.text: Spotify and Apple now dominate podcast distribution, recreating the gatekeeper problem all over again.

climax.text: Every new medium starts open and free. Then consolidation begins.

punchline.text: New medium, same cycle. Open, grow, consolidate.

quiz.question: What pattern do podcasts share with previous media?
options: They started open then became dominated by a few platforms
